title: Innervated mouse pancreas organoids as an ex vivo model to study pancreatic neuropathy
author: Besikcioglu, Yurteri, et al.

steps.title: Warm media aliquots for iPSC/NCC
steps.instruction: Remove Tesr_E8 medium aliquots (for iPSC culture) and Neural Crest Differentiation medium aliquots (for NCC differentiation) from the +4 °C refrigerator about 2 h before use and let them equilibrate to 20‑25 °C; do NOT place them in a 37 °C water bath.

steps.title: Thaw Matrigel for coating
steps.instruction: Place Matrigel hESC‑Qualified Matrix aliquots on ice and allow them to liquefy for approximately 1 h; aliquot size may be 150–200 µL for 12 mL coating medium, and consult the certificate of analysis for the exact dilution factor.

steps.title: Prepare and apply coating medium
steps.instruction: Make 12 mL coating medium by mixing ice‑cold DMEM/F12 with the Matrigel amount indicated in the certificate (e.g., 309 µL for 25 mL). Mix by pipetting, then add 6 mL to each 100 mm petri dish (or 1 mL per well of a 6‑well plate). Incubate ≥1 h at 20‑25 °C in a class II biosafety cabinet. Optional: prepare extra plates, seal with parafilm and store at 4 °C up to one week.

substeps.instruction: Fill a 15 mL conical tube with 12 mL ice‑cold DMEM/F12.
Add the Matrigel volume specified for 12 mL (derived from the certificate).
Mix gently by pipetting up and down with a 10 mL serological pipette.
Dispense 6 mL onto each 100 mm petri dish or 1 mL per well of a 6‑well plate.
Let the coating sit for at least 1 h at 20‑25 °C.

steps.title: Warm sterile PBS
steps.instruction: Place sterile PBS in a 37 °C water bath until warm.

steps.title: Pre‑warm adhesion plates for organoids
steps.instruction: Put 24‑well adhesion plates in a 37 °C incubator at least 24 h before starting the organoid culture.

steps.title: Thaw Matrigel BMM for organoid embedding
steps.instruction: Retrieve a 500 µL aliquot of Matrigel Basement Membrane Matrix (BMM) from –20 °C and keep on ice for 1.5 h until fully liquefied.

steps.title: Thaw growth factor and supplement aliquots
steps.instruction: Remove aliquots of mEGF, mNoggin, hFGF‑10, hGastrin‑I, B27 Supplement, N‑acetylcysteine, Nicotinamide, and R‑Spondin1‑conditioned medium from –20 °C and thaw on ice; thaw A83‑01 at 20‑25 °C.

steps.title: Make mouse organoid basic medium
steps.instruction: Prepare 500 mL mouse organoid basic medium by supplementing Advanced DMEM/F‑12 with GlutaMAX, HEPES, and Penicillin‑Streptomycin.

substeps.instruction: Open a new bottle of Advanced DMEM/F‑12 and dispense 15 mL.
Add 5 mL GlutaMAX (100×) using a 5 mL serological pipette.
Add 5 mL HEPES (1 M) using the same pipette.
Add 5 mL Penicillin‑Streptomycin (10 000 U/mL) using the same pipette.

steps.title: Assemble mouse organoid feeding medium
steps.instruction: Create 20 mL feeding medium by adding specific growth factors and supplements to the basic medium.

substeps.instruction: In a 50 mL conical tube, combine 18 mL mouse organoid basic medium.
Add 20 µL mEGF (1000×).
Add 20 µL mNoggin (1000×).
Add 20 µL hFGF‑10 (1000×).
Add 20 µL hGastrin‑I (1000×).
Add 50 µL N‑acetylcysteine (400×).
Add 200 µL Nicotinamide (100×).
Add 400 µL B27 Supplement (50×).
Add 2 mL R‑Spondin1‑conditioned medium.

steps.title: Warm feeding medium
steps.instruction: Place the mouse organoid feeding medium in a 37 °C water bath until warm.

steps.title: Pre‑warm plates for DRG isolation
steps.instruction: Put 24‑well plates in a 37 °C incubator at least 24 h before beginning DRG isolation.

steps.title: Prepare DRG collection medium
steps.instruction: Make DRG collection medium by supplementing MEM with Gentamicin.

substeps.instruction: Open a new 500 mL bottle of MEM and withdraw 400 µL.
Add 400 µL Gentamicin (50 mg/mL).

steps.title: Disinfect dissection hood and microscope
steps.instruction: Clean the dissection hood and stereo microscope with 70 % ethanol before DRG dissection.

steps.title: Set up DRG collection plate on ice
steps.instruction: Prepare an ice‑cold collection plate for DRGs.

substeps.instruction: Fill an ice bucket with ice and flatten the surface.
Place a 35 mm petri dish inside a 100 mm petri dish and set on the ice.
Add 2–3 mL DRG collection medium to the 35 mm dish.

steps.title: Pre‑warm plates for co‑culture
steps.instruction: Place 24‑well plates in a 37 °C incubator at least 24 h before starting co‑culture experiments.

steps.title: Thaw Matrigel BMM for co‑culture
steps.instruction: Retrieve Matrigel BMM aliquots from –20 °C and keep on ice until liquefied.

steps.title: Prepare co‑culture medium (add Y‑27632 first day)
steps.instruction: Form 20 mL co‑culture medium by supplementing mouse organoid basic medium with N‑Acetylcysteine and B27; add Y‑27632 (20 µL, 1000×) only on the first day of co‑culture.

substeps.instruction: Fill a conical tube with 20 mL mouse organoid basic medium.
Add 50 µL N‑Acetylcysteine (400×).
Add 400 µL B27 Supplement (50×).
For the first day, add 20 µL Y‑27632 (1000×).
